title: A Letter to the Bank
text:
Maria wrote a formal letter to the bank. She started the letter with 'Dear Sir or Madam' and explained that her card did not work. She asked the bank to check her account and to send an answer within ten days.

At the end of the letter, Maria wrote 'Yours faithfully' and signed her full name. She also added her address and her phone number, so the bank could contact her easily. The letter was short, polite, and clear.

questions.text: What problem did Maria write about in her letter?
options: Her account was closed by a friend

questions.text: What did Maria add to the end of the letter?
options: Her address and her phone number
A list of her favourite shops

questions.text: Why did Maria write 'Dear Sir or Madam' at the start?
options: She did not know the name of the person she was writing to
She was writing to her best friend
She wanted to send a birthday message
She had already spoken to the same person

questions.text: What can you infer about the tone of Maria's letter?
options: It is very long and confusing

vocabulary.definition: a written message sent to another person by post
an arrangement with a bank that lets you keep and use money
the place where a person lives or where a letter should be sent
showing respect and good manners when speaking or writing

paragraph_translations: Maria escreveu uma carta formal para o banco. Ela começou a carta com 'Dear Sir or Madam' e explicou que o seu cartão não funcionava. Ela pediu ao banco que verificasse a sua conta e que enviasse uma resposta em dez dias.

No final da carta, Maria escreveu 'Yours faithfully' e assinou o seu nome completo. Ela também acrescentou o seu endereço e o seu número de telefone, para que o banco pudesse entrar em contato com ela facilmente. A carta era curta, educada e clara.
